summary: Wired all 5 unused CaldavMetrics counters (record_malformed_request, record_oversized_body, record_not_found, record_precondition_failed, record_internal_error) into the DAV HTTP error response path by adding a &CaldavMetrics parameter to each error helper function and recording the appropriate metric before returning the response.
important_context: Added new dav_oversized_body() helper that records record_oversized_body() for the 3 'request body too large' call sites, distinguishing them from generic malformed requests
